projection.clip: Require finite homogeneous values,w>0,inclusive -w<=x/y/z<=w before division.
projection.matrix: Finite column-major OpenGL f32 coefficients, f32 source points evaluated in deterministic scalar f64 arithmetic; no determinant condition.
projection.report: projected_vertices counts all clip-eligible points, including empty rectangles/selections.
projection.through_depth: All eligible active-object vertices at any eligible depth are classified. No backface, visible-surface, occlusion or inactive-object query.

owner.scope: Independently written pure-Rust through-depth rectangle/lasso vertex masking; focused native acceptance, no reference parity claim.

selection.boundary: Fixed absolute1e-7 caller screen-unit Euclidean distance to finite segment, with expanded segment bbox. Hypot/unit direction plus endpoint distance avoids short-edge squared underflow; zero edge uses point Euclidean distance.
selection.lasso: 3–512 raw stored points, at least3 non-collinear distinct points. All ordered repetitions/closing points retained; even-odd rule (including double traces/self-crossings/bowtie with zero shoelace area).
selection.masks: Selected weights become1, or0 for erase. Numerically equal original bits retained, including signed zero; no pressure/alpha/symmetry/soft falloff and no faces cut.
selection.rectangle: Reversed corners supported; exact inclusive bounds; zero width or height valid empty/no-op. polygon_points=4 conceptual corners, point_edge_work=0.
selection.validity: Direct f64 orientation with independently normalized-direction fallback avoids tiny determinant underflow; no new minimum extent. This is not an arbitrary-precision exact-real predicate claim across all floating dynamic ranges.

transaction.barriers: Finish valid pending stroke first; invalid pending stroke restores and rejects dependent operation; hidden active rejects.
transaction.no_op: Empty/all-target/equal-bit result returns before candidate normalization/history, preserving redo and unreconciled hidden baselines.
transaction.shared_helper: Existing filter candidate checks factored verbatim into private commit_mask_candidate; both scalar filter and region use the same mask-only commit.
transaction.unchanged: Positions/normals/RGB/triangles/adjacency, f64 layers/targets, active level/IDs/visibility and inactive payload Arcs; retained masks follow existing f32 reconciliation policy.
transaction.useful_edit: Validate candidate existing multires mask transport/layer composition/Morph binding/scene+output budget before installing only masks and one whole-scene history state.

Shared mask-only candidate helper is factored from prior filter guard unchanged: layers/Morph/retained output/aggregate budgets checked before masks-only install and one whole-scene undo.
